title: "01 — Inputs and scope"
format: html
execute: {echo: false, warning: false, message: false}
---

## Purpose

Document configured sources, experiment scope, and canonical snapshot checks.

## Inputs

`config/analysis.R`, the configured network source, and the experiment registry.

## Decisions and exclusions

This step inventories sources and defines scope; it makes no downstream species exclusions.

## Before/after counts and validation checks

```{r}
cfg <- targets::tar_read(config)
inventory <- targets::tar_read(input_inventory)
sources <- targets::tar_read(canonical_scientific_source_inventory)
validation <- targets::tar_read(canonical_validation)
experiments <- targets::tar_read(experiments)
cat("Configured network input:", cfg$input_rdata, "\n\n")
cat("Analysis experiments:", nrow(experiments), "\n\n")
knitr::kable(inventory)
knitr::kable(validation)
knitr::kable(
  sources |>
    dplyr::count(.data$source_role, name = "files") |>
    dplyr::arrange(.data$source_role)
)
knitr::kable(sources)
```

## Problems flagged

Missing sources, invalid experiment identifiers, or failed canonical snapshot checks stop the target.

## Canonical outputs

`input_inventory`, `experiments`, `canonical_validation`, and
`canonical_scientific_source_inventory`.

## PASS/FAIL

The report is produced only after the canonical input and experiment targets succeed.
